description: This Java source file defines the class JMSMessageWorkaround, which extends JmsMessage to override certain behaviors for handling JMS messages, specifically to prevent the Qpid client from setting AMQP properties. It acts as a wrapper around JmsMessage, delegating most methods and overriding setters to do nothing if already set.
